name: Heather Brooks
source:
When not harassing the writing club, Heather can often be found watching old films in the A.V. room.

It's unknown why she has access to the room, but it's easy to assume intimidation played a factor.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/vnstudioelan/status/1617923314114265091]Twitter[/url]]
